stage: F04 disconnect/reconnect and recovery readback software
implemented: Disconnect preserves the exact Worker handle, retires the old epoch context and never stops a shared server.
Reconnect reuses the original Worker without birth, verifies endpoint/version/build, advances epoch and invalidates old handles.
Lifecycle retirement atomically refuses accepted work; uncertain binding quarantine rejects future submissions while preserving already accepted task ownership.
Credentials are re-resolved from an in-memory opaque reference before any reconnect detach; secrets are not persisted.
Recovery queries original recorded Worker request IDs and appends observations without replaying requests or resolving original UNKNOWN history.
